title: SREV-062 GUI DispatchMessage stub parser contract

dispatch_message_a_stub.description: DispatchMessageA exported entry bytes accepted by the local parser

dispatch_message_w_stub.description: DispatchMessageW exported entry bytes accepted by the local parser

worker_target.description: Shared worker address derived only after both stubs are schema-valid

contracts: DispatchMessageA and DispatchMessageW are same-shape User32 exported APIs, but their entry byte layout is not a Win32 API contract
The local A-stub parser accepts only BA 01 00 00 00 followed by EB rel8 or E9 rel32
The local W-stub parser accepts only 33 D2 followed by EB rel8 or E9 rel32
Unknown A-side or W-side opcodes must fail closed before derived-target comparison
The DispatchMessage8 hook may be installed only when the A-side and W-side derived targets are equal
